authority: Executive Council / Bennett University Act 2016 (UP Act No. 24 of 2016, Clause 29)
attendance_threshold: General mandate; requires students to obey program attendance rules (Page 31-32)
disciplinary_scope: Foundational statutory authority for Proctorial Board, Student Welfare Officer, and VC disciplinary powers (Pages 45-48)
limitations_and_conflict_notes: Foundational statutory charter. Does not specify numeric attendance percentage; delegates program rules to Academic Council / Ordinances.

authority: Vice Chancellor under Bennett University Statutes
attendance_threshold: Non-numeric; persistent irregularity in attendance/absence without leave treated as act of indiscipline (Clause 4.1)
disciplinary_scope: Comprehensive proctorial procedure, hostel regulations, anti-ragging penalties, disciplinary committee constitution, appeal to VC
limitations_and_conflict_notes: Governs non-academic student conduct and proctorial hearings. Does not govern course grading or exam eligibility thresholds.

attendance_threshold: Mandates signing examination attendance slip prior to exiting exam hall (Page 1)
disciplinary_scope: Specific to Examination Hall misconduct; defines 12 categories of unfair means and graduated penalties from paper cancellation to expulsion
limitations_and_conflict_notes: Confined to examination malpractice procedures and penalties. Operates concurrently with general Student Conduct rules.

authority: Dean, School of Computer Science Engineering & Technology (SCSET)
attendance_threshold: 70% minimum attendance in course lectures, tutorials, and labs combined; <70% results in X grade / debarment (Clause 30.1(ii), Page 19). Max 10% relaxation for medical/university deputation (Clause 30.1(v)).
disciplinary_scope: Academic load restrictions, X-grade debarment, semester withdrawal (Clause 30.2), academic termination for unauthorized absence (Clause 30.3)
limitations_and_conflict_notes: Program handbook specifies 70% attendance. Textually conflicts with university-wide Notification 307/2022 (75%) for unanchored queries; requires CONFLICTING_VERSIONS status or version disclosure.

authority: Registrar (Col Guljit Singh Chadha, Retd) / 13th Academic Council Resolution in consonance with UGC Regulations 2003
program_applicability: All Students across all schools appearing in End Semester Examinations
effective_date: 2022-09-08 (with effect from AY 2022-23 odd semester onwards)
attendance_threshold: 75% minimum attendance to become eligible for appearing in End Semester Examination (Page 1)
disciplinary_scope: Debarment from End Semester Examination by Controller of Examination (CoE)
limitations_and_conflict_notes: Sets 75% threshold for End Semester Exam eligibility under UGC mandate. Does not explicitly cite or repeal Clause 30.1 of SCSET rules, creating apparent dual threshold (70% course grade vs 75% exam hall).

authority: School of Engineering and Applied Sciences (SEAS) / Academic Council
attendance_threshold: 70% minimum attendance in course lectures, tutorials, and practicals combined; <70% results in X grade / debarment (Clause 30.1(ii), Page 28)
disciplinary_scope: Historical X-grade debarment, promotion backlogs, semester withdrawal
limitations_and_conflict_notes: Historical ordinances. Superseded by SCSET UG Rules for AY 2022-23 cohorts onwards; retained in corpus for historical query provenance.
